OPER-003.summary: Removal does not rewrite history: removing an operator revokes their sessions and keeps their name on campaigns, approval requests, approvals, revisions and audit records, proven through review, detail and activity at 1440 and 390.

OPER-007.summary: Activity log: the Owner and Admins read Settings → Activity, filtered by operator, agent, action, object and date with a CSV of the filtered view. The clause now names that flow activations and pauses (FLOW-008) and agent actions (AGENT-010) join the log when those clauses are built. Status stays partial: a completed restore has no activity entry yet.

AUD-003.summary: Commerce and dormancy exclusions: review lists recent-purchase, unresolved-refund, unresolved-return and dormant exclusions with their counts at 1440 and 390.

MSG-005.summary: SMS opt-out: review of an SMS step shows the program identity, Reply STOP to unsubscribe, the frequency disclosure, the help contact and the segment count.

MSG-006.summary: Links: review and approval name every blocked link and image with the scheme, fault or host that blocks it; only unlisted HTTPS hosts offer Allow this host.

MSG-015.summary: Allow a blocked host from review: a Manager allows an unlisted host from review, Authors cannot, checks rerun, and the allowance is recorded with operator, host and campaign.

INT-004.summary: Stripe: an owner-only encrypted Stripe connection and signed once-only commerce event ingestion. A real Stripe subscription lifecycle is not proven yet.

FLOW-001.summary: Visual flow builder: inherits INT-004's Stripe renewal-reminder enrolment for when flows are built; status unchanged (missing).

FLOW-002.summary: Triggers: inherits INT-004's Stripe subscription-event enrolment for when flows are built; status unchanged (missing).

FLOW-008.summary: Reviewed activation: activation, pause and archive of a flow revision will each be an OPER-007 activity entry; status unchanged (missing).

AGENT-010.summary: Agent authority and guardrails: every agent action will be an OPER-007 activity entry under the agent's grant; status unchanged (partial).

CAMP-019.summary: Status stays partial. Extend the existing typed-test journey with Activity actor/time, action/object filters, CSV and erased-contact redaction at desktop and phone widths.

BUILD-002.summary: Status stays partial. Archive templates enter the library with untouched-only undo; the first save of an imported or generated design files an independent template. Existing archive draft custody retains its undo path. No migration is needed.

DELIV-008.summary: Status stays partial. Carry the SendGrid Settings connection and signed webhook flow with a completed Activity receipt, Owner-only mutations and named Admin refusals. Migration 0097 is additive; existing developer inputs remain until a Settings connection is made. Resend, fresh Free/Assisted sign-in, alerts, full developer labeling, domain creation and provider sandbox proof remain open.

BUILD-010.summary: Generated responsive CSS and both-tree checks pass the existing 180-second canonical-save registration, including 138 adversarial cases, stored-body 375/600 standards/quirks renders with and without style, transmitted-byte accounting and Preview at 1440/390. The audit avoids sandbox child-frame discovery without losing shell rules or the eight direct email audits. Per-block controls, nested orientation and full editor acceptance remain open.
